scripts.check: npm run sdk:build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.dev: npm run sdk:build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:http://localhost:3000
scripts.deploy: npm run sdk:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run sdk:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
